title: Set opening hours and split opening periods
summary: Review the opening week and check affected appointments before saving.

sections.title: Understand the two schedules
sections.body: Location opening hours say when the branch is open. Team working hours say when a person can take appointments. Bookable time needs both. You need business-wide settings access to change location hours.

sections.title: Review and save your week
sections.body:
1. Open **Business setup → Opening hours**. Choose the location if you have more than one.
2. Select the open days and enter each day’s opening and closing times in the displayed location time zone.
3. Use **Add period** for a split day, such as 9 AM–1 PM and 2 PM–6 PM. Periods must not overlap.
4. Use **Copy to weekdays** only when the receiving weekdays should share those hours.
5. Select **Review hours**. Open any affected appointment in Calendar.
6. If you retain those visits, enter **Reason for retaining these appointments**.
7. Select **Save business hours**.

sections.title: Verify availability afterward
sections.body: Reopen the week to confirm it was saved, then inspect Calendar for a representative day. Review staff working hours if your business week changed; they are not automatically rewritten.

sections.title: When review or save fails
sections.body: Your edited week remains available after a recoverable review error. Resolve field messages and review again. Existing appointments keep their booked times; saving opening hours does not cancel or reschedule them. Save or discard the current week before switching locations.
